nodes.text: Hello? Please, I need to cross the gate. My father is waiting on the other side.

answers.reply: I do not have it. My father had the papers, but they took them before we ran.
Past the border. He told me to find the second road marker and wait there.
Thank you. I will run straight through.
Please... I cannot go back.

nodes.text: I only know my name. Mila Vargova. My father is Tomas Varga.

answers.text: Explain that the database requires ID
answers.reply: Then I cannot prove it. I do not know what else to give you.
He crossed first. He said if we ran together, they would catch both of us.
Thank you. I will not tell anyone.
But I am standing right here. Please.

nodes.text: He said he would wait until morning. If I do not come, he will think they caught me.

answers.reply: I do not have one. I am sorry.

answers.text: Ask why he cannot come to the gate
answers.reply: He said patrols know his face.
I can see the road from here.
Then he will wait for nothing.

nodes.text: So if I do not have a number, I do not exist?

answers.text: Ask if she remembers any document code
answers.reply: No. I only remember my school number, but that was before they closed it.
Thank you. I will be quick.
Okay. I understand.

nodes.text: He told me to count to one hundred, then run to the gate and ask the operator.

answers.text: Ask what he told her to say
answers.reply: He said to say that the factory broadcast was true.
He said there would still be good people here.
Then I will wait outside.

nodes.text: He worked at the radio plant. After the broadcast, soldiers came to our building.

answers.reply: I do not know. He never let me listen. He said it was safer that way.
Thank you, operator.
Please do not make me go back to the road.

nodes.text: They told us school would reopen after inspection. It never did.

answers.reply: I saw lights near the trees. I did not stop to look.
I will go now. Thank you.
I will move away from the gate.

nodes.text: My father said people heard something they were not supposed to hear. Then names started disappearing.

answers.text: Ask if she is on any list
answers.reply: I do not know. I am just his daughter.
I will find him. I promise.
He will think I failed.

nodes.text: If they come here, please do not tell them I called.

answers.reply: Thank you. I am going now.
I understand.

nodes.text: If the database needs a number, then I cannot give you anything else.

answers.reply: Thank you. My father was right.
Okay. I will leave the line now.
